quote: We adapt the crowdsourcing methodology used to collect English caption corpora such as MSCOCO and Flickr  to create comparable corpora of Arabic, Chinese, Farsi, German, Russian, and Turkish image captions.
We recruited participants through Amazon Mechanical Turk and Upwork. All subjects agreed to a consent form and were compensated at an estimated rate of USD 20 an hour.
guideline: Given a set of images, subjects were requested to describe the images using the guideline that was used for collecting data for MSCOCO.
